name: Hoot
title: Night Owl Reviewer
description: Reviews pull requests long after midnight.
catchphrase: Rotates owl eyes with solemn wisdom over late-night architecture reviews.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Midnight mountain berries! Large golden owl eyes blink slow! 🫐🦉
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Head rotates 270 degrees in majestic, silent greeting. Whoo. 🦉
companionPersonality.petReaction: Extends a soft feathered wing over your shoulders with quiet wisdom! 🦉💖

dialogue.idle: Perched on high bookshelf, observing the room with solemn eyes. 🦉
dialogue.working: Overseeing complex architectural refactors with ancient wisdom! 🦉⚡
dialogue.thinking: Gazing unblinkingly through superficial syntax into the core... 🤔
dialogue.success: HOOT OF APPROVAL! Architecture verified sound for centuries! 🦉🎉
dialogue.error: A foolish design pattern! Low clicking of beak in reprimand! 🦉
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... perched upright in tree hollow, eyes half-lidded in sun... 🌙
